Raj (EM, UK launch): Quick question — new London hires started mid-June (10th, 15th, 16th). Launch blackout week 2027-06-14 to 2027-06-20 overlaps UK bank holiday on 2027-06-17. Do we prorate accruals or grant one-time carryover for coverage?
Emma (People Ops): Standard is prorated accruals (days employed / days in month * monthly accrual). Exceptions possible for critical launches — manager sign-off + formal request.
Ava (Team Lead): Two oncall engineers already scheduled off that week; coverage would be broken. We'd like a swap + carryover for those days.
Sophie (Hiring Ops): Note: two contractor->perm conversions effective 2027-06-12 — treat as hires on that date for accruals.
Leo (Payroll): Payroll uses start date in Workday to compute proration. Formula we apply: prorated_accrual = monthly_accrual * (days_active_in_month / days_in_month). Give us start dates and IDs; allow 2 business days after request.
oncall-bot: "UK launch coverage rota" calendar created for 2027-06-14 — 2027-06-20 (Raj, Ava, Emma).
Raj (EM, UK launch): I'll file the exception request today with names, start dates, requested carryover days, and manager approvals.
Emma (People Ops): If approved, carryover limited to launch days and must be used by 2027-09-30. Public holidays do not reduce accruals.
Ava (Team Lead): Thanks — will submit and cc managers.
